title: PL_RM20-21 DUAL FLOW BIPROPELLANT LATCHING VALVE DEVELOPMENT
description: Currently there is in Europe neither an off-the-shelf dual flow bipropellant latching valve nor is there one under development. Latch valves are required for any bipropellant (e.g. NTO/MMH) propulsion system. Strictly speaking it is not necessary to use dual flowlatch valves, since however both fuel and oxidizer are always required simultaneously it makes from system point of view sense to use dual flow latch valves providing simultaneous supply of oxidizer and fuel.The goal of the activity is to increase the TRL on theequipment of a Dual Flow Bipropellant Latching Valve.The objective of this activity is the design, manufacturing, development and testing of an engineering valve model for the use with standard propellants (e.g. N2H4, MMH and N2O4). The compatibility with green propellants would be an asset. The activity shall include a requirement definition from a qualified source, demonstrate fast response times (e.g. < 10ms), excellent leak tightness after a representative life cycle and at temperature extremes and completion of a PDR datapack.

description: General DescriptionThis activity explores the application of Approximate Computing (AxC) techniques to GNSS signal processing for reducing power consumption while maintaining acceptable accuracy. It focuses on implementing AxC in acquisition, tracking, and PVT stages of GNSS receivers. The study will identify suitable AxC methods, develop a prototype receiver supporting both exact and approximate modes, and evaluate performance in terms of power efficiency, accuracy, and correlation degradation. title: IMPLEMENTATION OF MASSIVE MIMO FOR 5G BROADBAND COMMUNICATION SATELLITES (ARTES 4.0 SPL 5G/6G 5B.252) - EXPRO+
description: Objective: The objective of the activity is to develop new Active Antenna Systems with high flexibility to adapt to traffic requestwith increased total capacity and limited payload complexity. Targeted Improvements:40% throughput increase;50% beamforming complexity reduction;Description: MIMO (multiple-input multiple-output) has become increasingly important in the last generation of wireless networks, and Massive-MIMO (M-MIMO) is the key enabling technology of 5G networks. MIMO allows to maximise the reuse of the limited frequency resources and, in mobile networks, to mitigate the channel fading effects. The exploitation of MMIMO in the forward link of satellite systems requires large on-board active arrays which are subject of ongoing developments, however, the adoption of conventional Massive- MIMO for SatComs several technical challenges. Early approaches were based on accurate estimation of the Channel State Information (CSI), thus requiring regular reporting from the user equipment and tight control of the satellite payload radio frequency chains differential phase and amplitude error, to avoid performance degradation. The CSI update rate is even higher for Low Earth Orbiting (LEO) satellites due to the system orbital dynamic. Recent research has identified a number of key simplifications possible:- Replacing the channel state information with the user location information;- Converting the MIMO precoding into beam steering;- Making use on-board of Fast Fourier Transform beamforming and beam switching;- Approximating the Np-hard Radio Resource Management (RRM) with a linear complexity fast algorithm. and such pragmatic M-MIMO approach is showing excellent performance in non-uniform traffic scenarios with different distributions of the users.In this activity, pragmatic M-MIMO solutions will be further developed and applied to 5G and 6G via satellite. A scaled demonstrator, including a representative transmit active array with associated beamforming network, will be manufactured and tested with associated RRM processing, in order to verify the beamforming and RRM approach and associated advantages as compared to conventional MIMO schemes. The activity shall also estimate the Radio Access Network (RAN) implementation complexity.

title: ESPRIT HLCS RF Suitcase
description:
The European Systems Providing Refuelling, Infrastructure and Tele-communication) (ESPRIT) is one of the ESAs contribution to the Cislunar Gateway. It includes: (1) the HALO Lunar Communication System (HLCS) (2) A stand-alone Refuelling Module (RM) and (3) Fluid transfer connectors (FTC) for HALO and PPE to be integrated and launched with their docking mechanisms that are used for propellant transfer.
The Cislunar Gateway is a multi-element infrastructure designed to support both robotic and human exploration of cis-lunar space and act as a basecamp for sustained lunar exploration.. It is intended to be occupied by a crew of up to four astronauts for periods ranging from two weeks to two months, but otherwise operates as a robotic spacecraft.

The objective of the present procurement is the selection of the contractor for the ESPRIT-HLCS RF Suitcase in accordance with the principles of ESA Best Practices.
The supplier will be in charge of design, manufacturing and test for this EGSE.

title: Elektronenstrahlschmelzanlage
description: Es soll eine Anlage für das Elektronenstrahlschmelzen (Electron Beam Melting, EBM) zur additiven Fertigung von Bauteilen aus Mondstaub sowie Metallen für die Raumfahrt, Medizintechnik und Automobilindustrie beschafft werden. Die Anlage muss verschiedene Materialien verarbeiten können und über Standardverarbeitungsparameter für gängige Werkstoffe verfügen. Zudem soll sie die Möglichkeit bieten, neuartige und herausfordernde Materialien zu verarbeiten, wofür eine freie Wahl und Anpassung der Prozessparameter essenziell ist. Die Anlage sollte benutzerfreundlich sein und eine einfache Umrüstung zwischen verschiedenen Materialien ermöglichen. Wartung und Instandhaltung müssen mit minimalem Arbeitsaufwand durchführbar sein. Für die Verarbeitung herausfordernder Materialien wie Mondstaub ist eine indirekte Pulvervorheizung oder ein vergleichbares System erforderlich. Zudem sollte die Pulveraufbereitung und die Nachbearbeitung der Bauteile sowohl für Standard- als auch für anspruchsvolle Werkstoffe effizient gestaltet sein.

Tuotamme palveluita läheisessä yhteistyössä lukuisten kumppaneidemme kanssa. Pikaviestintä- ja häiriötilanneratkaisun hankinnan kilpailutuksessa tavoitteenamme oli löytää ratkaisu pikaviestintä- ja häiriötilanneviestintään eri omistaja-asiakkaillemme. Tilaajalla on solmittavan hankintasopimuksen perusteella oikeus käyttää palvelua itse sekä myydä palvelua eteenpäin nykyisille ja mahdollisesti tuleville asiakkailleen. Asiakkaat sijaitsevat pääsääntöisesti Lapin ja Pohjois-Pohjanmaan alueella. LapIT Oy (Tilaaja) pyysi tarjouksia organisaatioiden sisäisen pikaviestintä- ja häiriötilanneratkaisun kokonaispalvelusta. LapIT Oy toimii hankintayksikkönä ja vastaa Tilaajan roolissa hankinnan kilpailutuksesta. Tilaajalla on solmittavan hankintasopimuksen perusteella oikeus käyttää palvelua itse sekä myydä palvelua eteenpäin nykyisille ja mahdollisesti tuleville asiakkailleen. LapIT Oy vastaa Tilaajana ostopalvelusopimuksesta valittavan palveluntuottajan kanssa sekä palvelusopimuksista omistaja-asiakkaidensa kanssa. Hankinnan kohteena oli organisaatioiden sisäiseen viestintään sekä häiriötilanteisiin tarkoitettu tietoturvallinen pikaviestintä-, hälytys-, tiedotus- ja työhönkutsujärjestelmä, joka tulee LapIT Oy:n omistaja-asiakkaiden käyttöön.
